title: Zesty Smoky Slovakian Sausage Goulash
description: A spicy, aerated Slovakian dish featuring green cardamom pods and wok-hei, perfect for low-carb diets and festive gatherings.

ingredients.name: Slovakian Sausages
ingredients.notes: Use a combination of pork and veal for authentic flavor.

ingredients.name: Onions
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice the onions for optimal caramelization.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic adds depth to the goulash.

ingredients.name: Green Cardamom Pods
ingredients.notes: Crush the pods to release the aromatic oils.

ingredients.name: Smoked Paprika
ingredients.notes: Add a smoky flavor to the dish.

ingredients.name: Cayenne Pepper
ingredients.notes: Adjust the heat to your liking.

ingredients.name: Tomato Paste
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality tomato paste for a rich flavor.

ingredients.name: Chicken Broth
ingredients.notes: Low-sodium broth is essential for a balanced flavor.

ingredients.name: Heavy Cream
ingredients.notes: A small amount of cream adds a velvety texture.

instructions: Heat a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Add the minced garlic and crushed green cardamom pods, cooking for an additional minute.
Add the Slovakian sausages and cook until browned, breaking them apart with a spoon.
Add the smoked paprika, cayenne pepper, and tomato paste, stirring to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to aerate the goulash, or allow it to cool and blend in a stand mixer.
Stir in the heavy cream and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season the goulash with salt and pepper to taste.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
